summary.zh: 期末考试是每学期后期触发的全校事件。它会提高所有学生压力，并让组织在高压环境下面临更大的稳定风险。
summary.en: Final Exam is a late-semester campus-wide event. It increases stress for all students and makes the organization more fragile under pressure.

items.zh: 每学期第 25 到第 30 天会进入期末考试阶段。
items.en: Days 25 to 30 of each semester enter the final exam period.

items.zh: 事件会跟随学期循环重复出现。
items.en: The event repeats as semesters cycle.

items.zh: 考试期间所有学生都会获得压力。
items.en: All students gain stress during the exam period.

items.zh: 压力过高会降低学生能力表现。
如果压力达到极限，学生可能触发崩溃、失踪、退队或退出组织等事件。
items.en: If stress reaches the limit, students may trigger breakdowns, disappear, leave squads, or quit the organization.

items.zh: 考试周前应优先关注高压成员。
items.en: Before exam week, pay attention to highly stressed members.

items.zh: 休息行动和压力管理能力可以降低崩溃风险。
items.en: Rest actions and stress management can reduce breakdown risk.

items.zh: 在考试期间连续推进高风险行动，可能让组织稳定度快速恶化。
items.en: Pushing risky actions during exams may quickly damage organizational stability.
